name: alhangeul-tauri
description: Alhangeul desktop app for HWP and HWPX documents

scripts.build:before-tauri: pnpm run build:studio && pnpm run build:thumbnail-binaries
scripts.test: pnpm run test:upstream && pnpm run test:studio && pnpm run test:desktop
scripts.test:automation: node --test tests/desktop-artifacts.test.mjs tests/actions-workflows.test.mjs tests/thumbnail-core-probe.test.mjs tests/linux-thumbnail-core-probe.test.mjs tests/linux-thumbnail-build.test.mjs tests/thumbnail-build.test.mjs tests/windows-thumbnail-registration.test.mjs tests/product-boundary.test.mjs tests/product-version.test.mjs tests/release-metadata.test.mjs tests/rhwp-pin-fetch.test.mjs tests/rhwp-upstream-release.test.mjs tests/rhwp-upstream-release-policy.test.mjs tests/rhwp-managed-references.test.mjs tests/rhwp-sync-changes.test.mjs tests/rhwp-sync-pr-body.test.mjs tests/rhwp-upstream-sync-workflow.test.mjs tests/workflow-artifact-handoff.test.mjs tests/linux-gui-workflow.test.mjs tests/linux-gui-probe.test.mjs tests/gui-contracts.test.mjs tests/gui/linux/*.test.mjs tests/gui/linux/native-ui/*.test.mjs tests/windows-installer-smoke.test.mjs tests/windows-packaging.test.mjs
scripts.clippy:thumbnail-worker:windows: cargo clippy --manifest-path apps/thumbnail-worker/Cargo.toml --locked --target-dir apps/desktop/src-tauri/target --all-targets --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc -- -D warnings
scripts.clippy:thumbnail-handler:windows: cargo clippy --manifest-path apps/thumbnail-handler/Cargo.toml --locked --target-dir apps/desktop/src-tauri/target --all-targets --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc -- -D warnings
